subject: Synergos - Commercial readiness & pilot checklist
messages:
From: Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@synergos.io>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marta.liu@synergos.io
Date: 2027-12-04T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Commercial readiness & pilot checklist

Markus / Ben —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick note from our side to capture the things we covered and a few asks so we can move to procurement + internal sign-off. High-level items we agreed on:

- Pain: current latency and cost for embeddings at scale; several production incidents when model latency spikes.
- Goal: run a 6-week pilot with 2 production endpoints (in our us-west region) to validate 99th percentile latency and cost per embed reduction of ~30%.
- Data: will need SOC2 evidence and a short security summary for our InfoSec team.

Action items for Redwood we need:
1) A short mutual action plan with milestones and ownership (pilot readiness, security review, procurement approval, pilot kickoff).
2) Draft SOW + indicative cost for the 6-week pilot and what Dedicated capacity looks like vs hosted.
3) Security doc or checklist we can feed to InfoSec.

We're aiming to secure procurement approval by 2027-12-17 so we can kick off before the holidays if possible. I've copied Marta (procurement) who will own the contract lane.

Thanks — Ellis
Ellis Porter
Head of Platform Engineering | Synergos Health
ellis.porter@synergos.io
(415) 555-0198

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@synergos.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-04T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial readiness & pilot checklist

Ellis —

Appreciate the clear recap. Below is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) + next steps we discussed; I've put owners and target dates so procurement has something to work with. I attached draft SOW and a short security evidence summary.

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Pilot scope: 6-week evaluation, 2 endpoints (text-generation + embeddings), up to 5M tokens/month.
  Owner (Redwood): markus_klein.
  Owner (Synergos): Ellis Porter.
  Target: pilot kickoff 2027-12-20 (contingent on procurement).

- Security & compliance review: provide SOC2 summary, data handling controls, KMS options, and evidence artifacts.
  Owner (Redwood): laura_bennett.
  Owner (Synergos): Marta Liu (InfoSec/procurement intake).
  Target: 2027-12-10 (initial evidence package), final signoff 2027-12-16.

- Commercial & SOW: draft SOW + indicative cost for Hosted vs Dedicated options; include cost delta for reserved capacity.
  Owner (Redwood): ben_carter.
  Owner (Synergos): Marta Liu.
  Target: SOW draft 2027-12-06; procurement review complete 2027-12-17.

- Pilot success criteria & observability: 99th percentile latency <= 450ms for embeddings, cost/unit reduction >= 25%, and no production incidents attributed to inference runtime during pilot.
  Owner (Redwood/Redwood Console): markus_klein.
  Target: evaluation window during 6-week pilot.

Next steps I will do right away:
- Attach SOW-draft-v1.pdf and security-evidence-summary.pdf to this thread.
- Share a HubSpot playbook + link to a short demo recording of the Dedicated control plane.

Can you confirm Marta's procurement inbox is the right place for contract redlines and whether Synergos requires PO or Net-30 terms? Also confirm target for procurement decision (you mentioned 12/17 above). If that still stands we will prioritize the SOW and a minimal procurement addendum to speed review.

Thanks — we can be flexible on pilot start but faster procurement review helps secure capacity for the timeline you prefer.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
(650) 555-0133

Folks —

I pulled together a minimal procurement addendum and a suggested approval path (internal) for Redwood to keep the package lean. Key points I added in the draft:
- Pilot term: 6 weeks, auto-terminate unless both parties agree to extend.
- Data handling: customer-controlled KMS for encryption at rest option called out.
- SLA during pilot: best-effort but Redwood will provide 24/7 support escalation during business-critical windows in the pilot.

Ben — can you verify the cost table lines in the SOW match the Dedicated enablement fee we discussed? I'm proposing we include a capped overage rate so procurement has clear budget numbers.

Ellis / Marta — I'll drop the procurement addendum to the same Drive link Markus sent and flag items that typically trigger InfoSec follow-ups.

Laura Bennett
Legal & Compliance Partnerships | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Thanks, team — saw the SOW and security pack. Quick confirmations from procurement:
